title: Piggy Smallz
text:
A new mount trots into Hilde's stable.

✨ Piggy Smallz: a stout pack pig with a plaid saddle blanket, a bedroll, lanterns and a ring in his snout. Sold by Hilde the Stable Master for 75 gold at level 10, with +80% speed
✨ Piggy Smallz trots with short, bouncy strides, wags his curly tail, sniffs about when you stop, and his lanterns light up after dusk
• Riders now sit at the right height for each mount, so you sit snugly on the pig's back
